### COVID forbearance in our sample: when and on which vintages

Forbearance-flagged loan-months peak in **2020-06** (15,051 of 320,397 active loan-months). Of all forbearance loan-months in 2020–2021, **62%** fall on the 2015–2019 vintages, the loans outstanding when COVID hit, which is why ADR-001's COVID full-data vintage is 2019 (optionally 2017).
